blocks.text: What this usually means in UK cars

items.title: Short journeys are the primary cause
items.description: The DPF (Diesel Particulate Filter) traps soot from your diesel engine's exhaust. Over time, the DPF fills with soot. When it reaches about 45% capacity, the ECU initiates a regeneration - burning off the soot at 500-600°C.

blocks.text: The problem? Short journeys prevent the DPF from reaching this temperature. The DPF keeps filling until the warning light comes on.
In our 24,650 quote dataset, we identified three primary stages of DPF warning:

items: Orange DPF light (60% of cases) - Partial blockage. Need a motorway drive for passive regen. Cost: £0-£200.
Flashing DPF + engine light (25% of cases) - Advanced blockage. Professional forced regen needed. Cost: £100-£200.
DPF + engine light + limp mode (15% of cases) - Severe blockage. Cleaning or replacement needed. Cost: £300-£3,500.
Orange DPF = Partial blockage → Motorway drive for passive regen
Flashing DPF + engine light = Advanced blockage → Professional forced regen
DPF + engine light + limp mode = Severe blockage → Cleaning or replacement

blocks.text: What Causes DPF Blockage: “Short journeys prevent the DPF from reaching the temperature needed for regeneration (500-600°C). City driving is the primary cause.”

items.title: ⚠️ DPF WARNING - WHAT TO DO AT EACH STAGE

blocks.text: What it means: Partial blockage (45-80% full)
What to do: Drive at 40+ mph for 20-30 minutes at 2,000+ RPM
Why this works: The exhaust reaches 500-600°C, burning off the soot
If it doesn't: Move to Stage 2
What it means: Advanced blockage (80-95% full)
What to do: Book a professional forced regen
How it works: Garage forces the DPF to regenerate using diagnostic equipment
If it doesn't: Move to Stage 3
Stage 3: DPF + Engine Light + Limp Mode
What it means: Severe blockage (95-100% full)
What to do: Professional DPF cleaning or replacement
The DPF Delete Warning: “DPF removal or 'gut' services are illegal for road use and will fail MOT emissions testing.”
The Real-World Rule: “Act on the orange DPF light. If you ignore it, you're choosing between a £100 regen and a £1,000-£3,500 replacement.”
What happens if you ignore it - detailed progression

blocks.text: Important: Don't interrupt the regen once started. Turn off auto stop/start if possible. Monitor the DPF light - it should clear.
If the light doesn't clear: Move to a professional forced regen. Don't keep trying - you'll just waste fuel.

blocks.text: Ignoring the DPF light leads to complete blockage - then replacement (£1,000-£3,500).

You need to maintain 40+ mph for 20-30 minutes at 2,000+ RPM. A "quick blast" isn't enough.

items.title: Use the symptom pattern to understand the repair range

blocks.text: The £1,000+ Mistake: “I'll just ignore the orange DPF light - it'll go away.” It won't. It will turn into a £1,000-£3,500 replacement.
The DPF motorway regen - how to do it properly

items.title: Four steps to resolve your DPF warning

items: Step 1: Identify Your DPF Light - Orange static? → Motorway regen. Flashing + engine light? → Book forced regen. Limp mode? → Book diagnostic.
Step 2: If Orange DPF Light (Static) - Drive at 40+ mph for 20-30 minutes. Maintain 2,000+ RPM. Check if light clears.
Step 3: If Light Doesn't Clear OR Flashing - Book a professional diagnostic (£50-£150). Garage will perform a forced regen (£100-£200). If regen fails, cleaning or replacement needed.

Step 4: Professional Diagnostic (£50-£150) - A technician will check DPF soot level, perform forced regeneration, check for underlying causes (EGR, injectors, sensors), and recommend cleaning or replacement if regen fails.

blocks.text: Cost Disclaimer: Pricing is for UK independent specialists (2025-2026). Main dealers may charge 30-50% more. Regional variations apply. Costs exclude VAT unless stated.

blocks.question: What does the DPF warning light mean?
blocks.answer: The DPF is blocked with soot. It needs regeneration - either by driving or professionally.

blocks.question: Can I drive with the DPF light on?
blocks.answer: Yes - if it's orange (static). Drive at 40+ mph for 20-30 minutes. If it's flashing + engine light, get professional help.

blocks.question: How much does DPF replacement cost in the UK?
blocks.answer: DPF replacement costs £1,000-£3,500 depending on the vehicle and whether it's OEM or pattern.

blocks.question: Is DPF removal legal?
blocks.answer: No. DPF removal is illegal for road use and will fail MOT emissions testing.

blocks.question: How can I prevent DPF problems?
blocks.answer: Take your diesel car on a 20-30 minute motorway drive every 1-2 weeks. City driving is the primary cause of DPF blockage.
